overview: The Beach at Bude is a small boutique hotel on Summerleaze Crescent overlooking Summerleaze Beach in the centre of Bude. Alongside its hotel rooms and family suites it runs self-catering apartments and beachside townhouses, with a restaurant and a sea-view terrace bar.
surfTripFit: Looks straight onto Summerleaze, Bude's main town beach, and the site notes it is popular with surfers. Storage and parking are not stated.
